summary_1line: Janamejaya’s snake-sacrifice begins; priests chant as countless serpents are drawn into the fire while Takshaka seeks refuge with Indra.

image_candidates.scene_text: Priests in black garments with smoke-reddened eyes pour ghee into a roaring fire as multicolored serpents whirl through the air and fall into the flames.
Enormous snakes—some as long as a yojana, others thick as elephant trunks—twine together in terror before plunging into the sacrificial fire.
The serpent king Takshaka arrives in fear at Indra’s celestial palace, bowing and pleading for protection.
